title: JS Store Root Class
description: Make semio/js expose Store as the root owner for GraphQL transport and keep Kit beneath the Version interface shape from target.schema.graphql.
summary: Store is now the transport/root class, Kit is a schema entity below Version/TheKit, TheKit exposes readKit, and the React adapter uses StoreContext/useStore plus useRootKit for kit fields. Removed the root alias pattern (no kit: Store, no Store-as-Kit import, no openKit root helper).
